36331190.source: EMPA-KIDNEY (PMID 36331190, PMC9761906) full text: 'Ketoacidosis occurred in 6 patients in the empagliflozin group versus 1 patient in the placebo group (0.09 versus 0.02 per 100 patient-years).' Arm sizes empagliflozin 3304 vs placebo 3305 (the randomised/analysis population). SINGLE-TRIAL harm datum: the other two SGLT2-CKD trials pooled for the primary (DAPA-CKD 32970396, CREDENCE 30990260) do not expose per-arm ketoacidosis counts through the committed fetch path (neither is in PMC OA; abstracts give no DKA count), so this outcome is k=1 EMPA-KIDNEY only, not a representative SGLT2-CKD DKA pool.
36331190.verification: 6/3304 (empagliflozin) vs 1/3305 (placebo) verbatim in the committed full text; rare-event single-trial signal (RR ~6, very wide CI). Presented as single-trial (k=1), with sibling trials' DKA source-absent -- not a pooled class effect.
